title: Fathom
about: FATHOM: a diving bell's slot machine, upright and in 16 bits. Written in Sprout. Pull for lines across, down, in Vs and zigzags, build your own reels from a bag of symbols, pay the ship's air bill each dive, and buy relics from a hermit crab.
line: A portrait 16-bit slot roguelike on SPROUT·16: your reels are a bag of symbols you build, a monster every third dive, twenty-six relics and a hermit crab's salvage shop.
